ei.title: How to Love Your Life Again
ei.subject: 6월_2022 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: How to Love Your Life Again

fullPassage: Do you sometimes feel like you don't love your life? Like, deep inside, something is missing? That's because we are living someone else's life. We allow other people to influence our choices. We are trying to meet their expectations. Social pressure is deceiving — we are all impacted without noticing it. Before we realize we are losing ownership of our lives, we end up envying how other people live. Then, we can only see the greener grass — ours is never good enough. To regain that passion for the life you want, you must recover control of your choices. No one but yourself can choose how you live. But, how? The first step to getting rid of expectations is to treat yourself kindly. You can't truly love other people if you don't love yourself first. When we accept who we are, there's no room for other's expectations.

questions.passage: Do you sometimes feel like you don't love your life? Like, deep inside, something is missing? That's because we are living someone else's life. We allow other people to (A)[influence / ignore] our choices. We are trying to meet their expectations. Social pressure is (B)[deceiving / encouraging] — we are all impacted without noticing it. Before we realize we are losing ownership of our lives, we end up envying how other people live. Then, we can only see the greener grass — ours is never good enough. To regain that passion for the life you want, you must (C)[recover / abandon] control of your choices. No one but yourself can choose how you live. But, how? The first step to getting rid of expectations is to treat yourself kindly. You can't truly love other people if you don't love yourself first. When we accept who we are, there's no room for other's expectations.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) influence=영향을 미치다, (B) deceiving=속이는, (C) recover=회복하다. 다른 사람들이 우리 선택에 영향을 미치고, 사회적 압력이 속이며, 통제를 회복해야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① ignore(무시하다) - deceiving(속이는) - recover(회복하다): (A) ignore는 '무시하다'로, 타인이 선택에 영향을 미친다는 문맥에 맞지 않음
❌ ② influence(영향을 미치다) - encouraging(격려하는) - recover(회복하다): (B) encouraging은 '격려하는'으로, 사회적 압력이 속인다는 문맥에 반대
❌ ③ influence(영향을 미치다) - deceiving(속이는) - abandon(포기하다): (C) abandon은 '포기하다'로, 통제를 회복해야 한다는 문맥에 반대
✅ ④ influence(영향을 미치다) - deceiving(속이는) - recover(회복하다): 원문 일치 ←정답

questions.passage: Do you sometimes feel like you don't love your life? Like, deep inside, something is missing? That's because we are living someone else's life. We allow other people to influence our choices. We are trying to meet their expectations. Social pressure is deceiving — we are all impacted without noticing it. Before we realize we are (A)[losing / gaining] ownership of our lives, we end up envying how other people live. Then, we can only see the greener grass — ours is never good enough. To (B)[regain / surrender] that passion for the life you want, you must recover control of your choices. No one but yourself can choose how you live. But, how? The first step to getting rid of expectations is to (C)[treat / neglect] yourself kindly. You can't truly love other people if you don't love yourself first. When we accept who we are, there's no room for other's expectations.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) losing=잃는, (B) regain=되찾다, (C) treat=대하다. 삶의 소유권을 잃어가고, 열정을 되찾으며, 자신을 친절히 대해야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① gaining(얻는) - regain(되찾다) - treat(대하다): (A) gaining은 '얻는'으로, 소유권을 잃어가고 있다는 문맥에 반대
✅ ② losing(잃는) - regain(되찾다) - treat(대하다): 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ losing(잃는) - regain(되찾다) - neglect(무시하다): (C) neglect는 '무시하다'로, 자신을 친절히 대하라는 문맥에 반대
❌ ④ losing(잃는) - surrender(포기하다) - treat(대하다): (B) surrender는 '포기하다'로, 열정을 되찾으라는 문맥에 반대
det.tip: 소유권을 잃어가다 → 열정을 되찾다 → 자신을 친절히 대하다

questions.passage: Do you sometimes feel like you don't love your life? Like, deep inside, something is missing? That's because we are living someone else's life. We allow other people to influence our choices. We are trying to meet their expectations. Social pressure is deceiving — we are all impacted without noticing it. Before we realize we are losing ownership of our lives, we end up envying how other people live. Then, we can only see the greener grass — ours is never good enough. To regain that passion for the life you want, you must recover control of your choices. No one but yourself can choose how you live. But, how? The first step to getting rid of expectations is to treat yourself kindly. You can't truly love other people if you don't love yourself first. When we accept who we are, there's no room __________.
